title: MCP get_skill_graph Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `get_skill_graph` tool response, built by `_serialize_skill_graph`. U7/R4: the canonical skill graph — prerequisites, depth axis (canonical_stage), strand, and associated misconception ids, straight off the graph layer (orchestrator/catalog.py's SkillGraphResult), never the curriculum-local mapping view catalog-skills.schema.json describes. A requested-but-unknown skill_id is silently absent from `skills` rather than raising (plan point 6).
